LESSON: READING 11.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DIGITAL STORIES

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.2: Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories, part of Strand 11 in Grade 6 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

Key inquiry question: What role do pictures in a book or cover play in a story? 2. How are digital stories different from story books?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. participate in a reader’s theatre and read solo or choral poems on indoor games,

2. make predictions about a text by observing the cover or title,

3. make connections between the pictures in a text and real life situations,

4. summarise important ideas and restate them in own words,

5. retell events in a poem chronologically,

6. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of expressions similes, metaphors, idioms, proverbs and phrasal verbs.

7. summarise events in a text through retelling. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. participate in a reader’s theatre and read solo or choral poems on indoor games,
2. make predictions about a text by observing the cover or title,
3. make connections between the pictures in a text and real life situations,
4. summarise important ideas and restate them in own words,
5. retell events in a poem chronologically,
6. use contextual clues to infer the meaning of expressions similes, metaphors, idioms, proverbs and phrasal verbs.
7. summarise events in a text through retelling. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 11.2.1 Intensive Reading: Digital Stories together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: The learner’s ability to engage in self-driven tasks is enhanced while participating in a reader’s

theatre and reading solo or choral poems on indoor games.

• Creativity and Imagination: The learner’s ability to create mental images is developed through the tasks on creation

of mental images from viewed, heard or read texts.

Values:
Unity: This is inculcated in the learner while collaborating with peers and retelling events in a poem chronologically.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Learner Support Programmes: The learner is able to provide support to each other as they interact with reading texts

related to indoor sports and games.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate intensive reading to reading of passages and other texts on Kiswahili.
